title: Return eligibility and refund amount
prompt:
Hi, I'd like to return everything from order VA-10482. It was delivered on 2026-10-10 and today is 2026-11-09. I paid $6.95 for shipping. Here is the order:

| Line | Variant | Product | Qty | Unit price paid | Opened? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | FDN-004-201O | Aurevia Calm Foundation | 1 | $45.60 | yes |
| 2 | MSC-008-BLA | Aurevia Daylight Mascara | 1 | $19.20 | yes |
| 3 | LIP-003-02 | Moss & Mineral Luminous Lip Color | 1 | $33.00 | no |
| 4 | LIP-004-03 | Orrin Calm Lip Color | 2 | $16.00 | no |
| 5 | MSC-003-BLA | Tidepool Skin True Mascara | 1 | $20.00 | no |

Which lines can I return, and how much will I get back?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"returnable_lines": [line numbers], "refund_total": number}. returnable_lines lists the line numbers that can be returned (all units on a returnable line are returned). refund_total is the total refund in dollars with two decimals.
why_hard: The request is made exactly on day 30 (October has 31 days), which is still on time. Each line needs a different rule: the final-sale lipstick is only flagged in the catalog, not in the order; the mascara rule applies only to opened mascara; and the refund must use the price paid, not the list price, with shipping excluded.
traps: Counting 2026-10-10 to 2026-11-09 as 31 days and rejecting the whole return
Missing that LIP-003-02 is final sale (only visible in the catalog)
Rejecting the unopened mascara (line 5) by over-applying the mascara rule
Refunding list prices ($57.00 foundation) instead of the prices paid
